styles.name: charge-and-fire
styles.description: Side-on laser cannon: its charge meter fills and the beam it fires reaches across, sparking at the tip

styles.name: scanning-line
styles.description: Vertical beam sweeps back and forth; swept fraction fills to eased

styles.name: security-grid
styles.description: Corridor of emitter posts with red tripwires criss-crossing between them; bays disarm to green with progress

styles.name: prism-dispersion
styles.description: A white beam strikes a glass prism and fans out as a red-to-violet spectrum that reaches across with progress

styles.name: laser-light-show
styles.description: Concert laser rig: stage projectors throw sweeping fans of coloured beams; more projectors fire with progress

styles.name: range-finder
styles.description: Laser range finder pings a crosshair target that stands further away with progress, over a distance ruler

styles.name: mirror-bounce
styles.description: A beam ricochets between hatched mirrors on the ceiling and floor, reaching further down the chain with progress

styles.name: fiber-pulse
styles.description: Curving optical fiber: light zigzags down the core by total internal reflection, lit up to progress

styles.name: plasma-bolt
styles.description: A plasma-ball electrode discharges a forked lightning bolt that re-strikes each frame; reach = progress

styles.name: particle-accelerator
styles.description: Synchrotron ring with magnets: the energised arc grows with progress as a particle bunch laps ever faster

styles.name: disco-fan
styles.description: Radial fan of beams sweeps from a corner; beam count and arc = eased
